metadata.scenario: A prospect calls to express disappointment over the lack of communication from the support team. Category: Service Complaint. Flags: quality_complaint.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret speaking. Hi Margaret, this is Harold Gonzalez. Hi Harold! How can I assist you today? I wanted to talk about my recent experience with your support team. I’m sorry to hear that, Harold. What seems to be the issue? I've had a lot of trouble getting updates about my care schedule. I understand how important communication is, especially with your condition. Yes, it’s crucial for my COPD and cardiac monitoring. Absolutely. Can you share a bit more about what hasn’t been communicated? Well, I was supposed to have a follow-up visit last week, but no one called to confirm. I see. That’s definitely not the standard we aim for. Thank you for letting me know. I just feel left in the dark, and it makes managing my health stressful. I completely understand your frustration, Harold. We’ll work to improve this. I’d appreciate that. I really need consistency with my care. Of course, would you prefer we set reminders for your appointments as well? Yes, that would be really helpful. My wife can help keep track too. Great. I’ll make a note to have reminders sent out before each visit. Thank you, that should help a lot. You're welcome, Harold. Is there anything else on your mind? Well, I also wanted to ask if there are additional services available. Yes, we offer a range of services like skilled nursing and physical therapy. I might be interested in having a nurse come more regularly for vital checks. We can definitely arrange that. Our skilled nursing care is priced between $95 and $125. That sounds reasonable. Can we discuss that further? Absolutely! I’ll have our care coordinator, Lisa, give you a call to go over options. Perfect, I’d like to set that up. I’ll make sure she reaches out to you by tomorrow. Thank you, Margaret. I really appreciate your help with this. You’re welcome, Harold. I’m here to support you. Have a good day! You too, bye! Bye!
